about: The AE86's own_palette in car_normalize.py's order (the material names sorted), values from materials.py; changed: the glass (Material.011, was metal 1, rough 0.35, colour 0.07: a matt brown plate in the game) is dark tinted smooth glass, the rims (Material.003, was colour 0.04, metal 0.75, rough 0.48) gun metal with a shine. Used by tools/glb-palette.mjs; ae86.json has the same changes for the next Blender export. Tyres (Material.004, was metal 1): matt rubber, metal 0, rough 0.9. Rims settled on gun metal with less metal (0.7) so that the sunset sky does not turn them orange.
